_comment: The temporal anomalies' places: where travelling to an anomaly leaves one, and the guardian
who waits there (Managers/AnomalyPlaces.cs, Handlers/AnomalyHandler.cs).
Each place is three maps of subarea 916 «Anomalías temporales», named alike in the client's map
positions: the ENTRY, where the travel lands, with the exit back to the anomaly's zaap (its
element's gfx is one of 64415-64424) and a way into the ROOM -- a portal, or walking off the
edge where the map scrolls say so --; the ROOM, with the guardian's group; and the ARENA its
fights are held on.
MEASURED in two captures, 'Movimiento/entrar a mapa con vestigio de zaap-entrar en la
anomalia-salir-volver a entrar-lanzar combate-abandonar' and 'Movimiento/ruta muy larga zonas
pandala-sidimote-muchos interactivos': the travel's arrival cell, the exit, the group's cell and
facing and who is in it -- the guardian at level 200 with one brutoforme (race 194), one
cublaforme (195) and one kaxaforme (192) --, and for Noximilian's Workshop the arena (the jru
after the hqa). Anomaly 609 led to Noximilian's Workshop twice, 325 to Kelba Market, 807 to the
unnamed place of Qilby, 280 to Aguabrial's Cavern, 941 to Bonta Palace: which place an anomaly
opens on is not the zone's, and here it is drawn anew with each of its cycles.
INFERRED for the rest: which guardian stands in which place is JOL's table ('Anomalies
Temporelles - Généralités': Julith in the Cité de Brâkmar, Dathura in the Abysses du Temps,
the Larve de Rushu in the Horloge de Xélor, Percimol in the Village des Flaqueux, Agonie in the
Tour Minérale, the Champion de l'Aurore Pourpre in the Aurore Pourpre); the entry is the map with
the exit; the arena the map of the same name with the arena flags, or for Crimson Dawn and
Xelor's Clock the unnamed one in the same column of ids. Their groups' companions are drawn
from the three families. The Gólem malakita and Ondina have no place the data shows.
The clocks (Noximilian's Workshop): «El reloj indica {0}:{1}.» (info 120) with the hour of
Paris, two digits, and its minutes -- «00», «26» at 22:26 UTC in summer --; the wrong one, «Este
reloj no marca la hora correcta, indica {0}:{1}.» (127), «4», «26», four hours on.
vestigeStaging is the hpm every anomaly's zaap map plays at its end while the anomaly is open.
